applicabilityBasis.summary: Umbrella stkGHO is an ERC-4626 staking receipt representing GHO contributed to automated deficit coverage. Redemption delivers GHO after a cooldown at an exchange rate that can decrease through slashing; rewards are claimed separately. It represents a risk-absorption protocol position without a fixed national-currency redemption obligation, outside GENIUS section 2(22).

GENIUS Act Public Law 119-27: sections 2(17) and 2(22)

genius.notes: The assessment covers Umbrella stkGHO.v1, separately from GHO, legacy Safety Module stkGHO, and the non-slashable sGHO savings vault. Aave's technical documentation explicitly distinguishes all three staking/savings paths. GHO staking does not itself accrue underlying lending yield; it earns separately claimable Safety Incentives while accepting deficit slashing and withdrawal constraints. The underlying GHO's unsettled payment-stablecoin applicability is not inherited by this risk-absorption receipt. Aave DAO governance or Aave Labs interface operation does not establish a corporate legal token issuer, so issuerEntity and licensing fields are omitted. No payment-stablecoin authorization is asserted.
